Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks and identify the reasons for choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks and explain the reasons for choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks, using observation and prior knowledge to provide reasons and construct arguments for choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks, using discipline knowledge to provide reasons and evaluate arguments for choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks by connecting evidence from within and across discipline areas to provide reasons and evaluate arguments for choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Analysing - Draw conclusions and provide reasons
Description: Draw conclusions and make choices when completing tasks, using analysis of complex evidence and arguments before making recommendations.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate whether they are satisfied with the outcome of tasks or actions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate whether they have accomplished what they set out to achieve including, using a given set of criteria to support decisions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate the outcome of a task by explaining ideas, conclusions and actions, including using a given set of criteria to support decisions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate the effectiveness of a course of action or the outcome of a task, including using a given or co-developed set of criteria to support decisions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate the effectiveness of a course of action or the outcome of a task and account for expected and unexpected results, including using a given or co-developed set of criteria to support decisions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Analysing - Evaluate actions and outcomes
Description: Evaluate the effectiveness of a course of action to achieve desired outcomes and suggest improvements, including using a personally developed set of criteria to support judgements and decisions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify the main parts of a concept or problem.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify the main parts of a concept or problem and describe how these relate to each other.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify and prioritise significant elements and relationships within a concept or problem.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify the relevant and significant aspects of a concept or problem, understanding that approaches may change depending on the subject or learning area.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify the relevant aspects of a concept or problem, recognising gaps or missing elements necessary for understanding by using approaches and strategies suitable for the context.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Analysing - Interpret concepts and problems
Description: Identify the objective and subjective aspects of a complex concept or problem, with sensitivity to context.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives by suggesting a different way to approach a given task or problem.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives and explore different or creative ways to approach a task or problem.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives by comparing different or creative ways to approach a task, issue or problem and recommend a preferred option.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives by challenging or creatively adjusting existing ideas in situations where current approaches do not work and recommend a preferred option.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives by creatively adapting ideas when information is limited or conflicting and recommend a preferred option.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Generating - Consider alternatives
Description: Consider alternatives by creatively revising and modifying ideas and recommendations when circumstances change.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Use imagination to create possibilities by exploring and connecting ideas in ways that are new to them.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Create possibilities by connecting or creatively expanding on ideas in ways that are new to them.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Create possibilities by connecting or creatively expanding on new and known ideas in a variety of ways.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Create possibilities by changing, combining, or elaborating on new and known ideas in a variety of creative ways.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Create possibilities by adapting, combining or elaborating on new and known ideas, and proposing a range of different or creative combinations.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Generating - Create possibilities
Description: Create possibilities by connecting or adapting complex ideas and proposing innovative and detailed variations or combinations.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action through trial-and-error experiences.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action by experimenting with options and predicting possible results.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action by predicting an outcome, trialling options and assessing their effectiveness.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action by predicting potential or future outcomes and systematically testing a range of options.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action by making predictions, testing and evaluating options, and reconsidering approaches in complex or unfamiliar situations.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Generating - Put ideas into action
Description: Put ideas into action by making predictions, testing and evaluating options, proposing modifications and adapting approaches in complex or unfamiliar situations.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to explore a familiar idea or topic.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed reflect their curiosity about the world.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to explore a familiar idea or topic.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed are fit for the purpose of the investigation.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to examine unfamiliar ideas and topics.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed support the process of improving knowledge and understanding about a topic or investigation.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to examine unfamiliar ideas and topics.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed focus on improving understanding about a topic and clarifying information about processes or procedures.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to investigate complex issues and topics.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed assist in forming an understanding of why phenomena or issues arise.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Develop questions to investigate complex issues and topics.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Inquiring - Develop Questions
Description: Questions developed facilitate increasing understanding of abstract ideas and concepts.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and explore relevant points in information provided on a topic.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Prioritise the information that is most relevant to the topic of study.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and explain similarities and differences in selected information.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and explore relevant information from a range of sources, including visual information and digital sources.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Condense and combine selected information related to the topic of study.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and examine relevant information and opinion from a range of sources, including visual information and digital sources.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Compare information and opinion that can be verified against claims based on personal preference.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and examine relevant information and opinion from a range of sources, including visual information and digital sources.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Evaluate the accuracy, validity and relevance of the information and opinion to the topic of study.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and clarify significant information and opinion from a range of sources, including visual information and digital sources.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Evaluate the information selected to determine bias and reliability.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Inquiring - Identify, process and evaluate information
Description: Identify and clarify significant information and opinion from a range of sources, including visual information and digital sources.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Identify thinking and learning strategies used when completing activities and drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Identify and describe thinking and learning strategies they have used when completing activities and drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Select, describe and reflect on the thinking and learning strategies and processes used when completing activities and drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Identify and reflect on thinking and assumptions when completing activities or drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Invite alternative perspectives or feedback in order to improve future outcomes.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Invite alternative perspectives and feedback, and consider reasonable criticism to adjust thinking and approaches.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Reflect on the thinking and processes used when completing activities or drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Identify possible limitations in their own positions by considering opposing viewpoints, reasonable criticism and feedback.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Reflecting - Thinking about thinking (metacognition)
Description: Reflect on the thinking and processes used when completing activities and drawing conclusions.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L1 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge
Description: Connect ideas and information between familiar learning experiences.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L2 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge
Description: Use ideas and information from a previous experience to inform similar learning experiences.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L3 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge
Description: Use aspects of knowledge and skills gained in one setting to inform learning in a new setting or context.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L4 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge
Description: Apply aspects of knowledge and skills gained in one context to a new or unrelated context to achieve a specific purpose.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L5 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge
Description: Transfer knowledge and skills gained in previous experiences to both similar and different contexts, and explain reasons for decisions and choices made.

Title: Critical and Creative Thinking: L6 - Reflecting - Transfer knowledge

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Creating and Exhanging - Create, communicate and collaborate
Description: Experiment with the features of familiar digital tools to create content.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Creating and Exhanging - Create, communicate and collaborate
Description: Use the core features of a range of digital tools to create content and communicate and collaborate with peers and trusted adults.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Creating and Exhanging - Create, communicate and collaborate
Description: Select and control a variety of features in appropriate digital tools to create content and communicate and collaborate with trusted groups.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Creating and Exhanging - Create, communicate and collaborate
Description: Select and control advanced features of appropriate digital tools to independently create content and effectively communicate and collaborate with wider groups.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Creating and Exhanging - Create, communicate and collaborate
Description: Select and control the features of digital tools to purposefully create content and effectively communicate and collaborate, inclusive of diverse groups.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Creating and Exhanging - Plan
Description: Use simple digital tools to contribute to a basic plan to complete a task.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Creating and Exhanging - Plan
Description: Use familiar digital tools to develop and follow a basic plan to complete a task.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Creating and Exhanging - Plan
Description: Select and use digital tools to develop and follow a plan to complete individual tasks and group projects.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Creating and Exhanging - Plan
Description: Use simple planning tools to develop and follow a plan to complete individual and collaborative projects.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Creating and Exhanging - Plan
Description: Use project management tools to develop and track a plan to complete individual and collaborative projects.

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Creating and Exhanging - Respect intellectual property
Description: Identify who owns class data.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Creating and Exhanging - Respect intellectual property
Description: Recognise ownership of products that others produce or that are produced collaboratively.

Description: Respect products created by someone else by acknowledging when they use them and use strategies such as indicating the source.

Description: Respect intellectual property by identifying the legal obligations regarding the ownership and appropriate use of products, exploring copyright protocols and applying some referencing conventions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Creating and Exhanging - Respect intellectual property
Description: Respect intellectual property by applying practices that comply with ethical and legal obligations, referencing conventions and copyright protocols.

Description: Respect intellectual property by identifying and applying practices that meet legal and ethical obligations, referencing conventions, copyright and trademark protocols.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Investigating - Acquire and collate data
Description: Collect data by counting, measuring and observing with familiar digital tools.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Investigating - Acquire and collate data
Description: Collect and access data using a range of digital tools and methods in response to a defined question.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Investigating - Acquire and collate data
Description: Collect and access data using a range of digital tools and methods in response to a defined question or problem.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Investigating - Acquire and collate data
Description: Collect and access data from a range of sources, using specialised digital tools in response to problems, and evaluate it for relevance.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Investigating - Acquire and collate data
Description: Collect and evaluate quantitative and qualitative data using specialised digital tools and processes in the context of identified problems.

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Use simple digital tools to explore sorting data and information provided as part of learning experiences.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Classify and group data using digital familiar tools to answer simple questions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Organise, summarise and visualise data using a range of digital tools to identify patterns and answer questions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Analyse and visualise data using a range of digital tools to identify patterns and make predictions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Analyse and visualise data by selecting and using a range of digital tools to infer relationships and make predictions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Investigating - Interpret data
Description: Analyse and visualise multidimensional data by selecting and using a range of interactive tools to draw conclusions and make predictions.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Investigating - Locate information
Description: Locate information through search engines and in documents by applying search terms, and select relevant information.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Investigating - Locate information
Description: Locate information through search engines and in documents by applying specific search terms, and selecting and retrieving relevant information from multiple sources.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Investigating - Locate information
Description: Locate information through search engines and in documents by applying specific search terms based on set criteria, and select and retrieve relevant information from multiple sources.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Investigating - Locate information
Description: Locate, select and retrieve relevant information from multiple sources, exploring advanced search functions and targeted criteria.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Investigating - Locate information
Description: Locate relevant information by applying advanced search functions across multiple sources involving purposefully selected and contextually specific terms and criteria.

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Managing and operating - Manage content
Description: Save and retrieve content in an app.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Managing and operating - Manage content
Description: Save and retrieve content with an agreed name.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Managing and operating - Manage content
Description: Save and retrieve content in agreed locations with an appropriate name.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Managing and operating - Manage content
Description: Store content using appropriate names and folders for ease of retrieval.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Managing and operating - Manage content

Description: Save and access content in their individual school account.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Managing and operating - Protect content
Description: Save and access content in shared folders using their individual school account.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Managing and operating - Protect content
Description: Protect content when sharing with peers and trusted adults by setting appropriate access controls.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Managing and operating - Protect content
Description: Protect content when sharing by selecting appropriate access controls for individuals and shared links for wider groups.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Managing and operating - Protect content

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Use simple digital tools to explore tasks and consolidate learning.

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Seek help when encountering a problem.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Attempt to solve a problem before seeking help.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Use familiar digital tools to complete tasks and consolidate learning.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Attempt to solve a problem individually and with peers before seeking help.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Select and use a range of digital tools to complete tasks.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Select and use the core features of digital tools to efficiently complete tasks.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Troubleshoot basic problems and identify repetitive tasks to automate.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Select and use the advanced or unfamiliar features of digital tools to efficiently complete tasks.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Troubleshoot common problems and automate repetitive tasks.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Select and operate advanced and emerging digital tools confidently.

Title: Digital Literacy: L2 - Managing and operating - Select and operate tools
Description: Troubleshoot common problems systematically and seek to improve efficiency by developing new skills.

Title: Digital Literacy: L1 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Recognise that online tools (website and apps) store their personal data, which may give an impression of them.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Give and seek consent before sharing online with peers and trusted adults.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Identify their digital footprint (personal data stored by online tools).

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Recognise their digital identity represents them online and can give a negative impression.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Give and seek consent before sharing online in trusted groups.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Recognise the permanence of their digital footprint and digital identity, and the associated risks, including to their reputation.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Consider who they trust with their data and review privacy policies before giving consent, and seek consent before sharing online.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Recognise their digital footprint is valuable, used by online tools for targeting, and that data shared online is no longer under their control.

Description: Consent selectively to data collection after assessing the benefits and risks of an online tool privacy policy.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Manage their digital identity by controlling privacy, connections and group settings, and curating posts.

Title: Digital Literacy: L3 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital privacy and identity
Description: Recognise their actions contribute to their passive digital footprint.

Description: Follow adult directions for the use of digital tools at school and home.

Description: Follow agreed rules for the healthy use of digital tools and apply them at school and home.

Description: Follow an agreed code of conduct for the healthy use of digital tools.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital wellbeing
Description: Follow an agreed code of conduct for the healthy and productive use of digital tools, considering the impact of tool use on wellbeing.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital wellbeing
Description: Develop routines to support their balanced and constructive use of digital tools.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital wellbeing
Description: Identify indicators of unhealthy usage.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital wellbeing
Description: Identify how tools are designed to capture their attention.

Title: Digital Literacy: L6 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage digital wellbeing

Description: Use online tools that are age appropriate or only under supervision, seeking help from trusted adults when feeling unsafe.

Description: Report negative or harmful online behaviour by seeking help from trusted adults.

Title: Digital Literacy: L4 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage online safety
Description: Recognise when to step away from negative online social interactions.

Description: Report negative or harmful online behaviour to trusted adults and know how to report it in online tools.

Title: Digital Literacy: L5 - Practising digital safety and wellbeing - Manage online safety
Description: Identify online abuse and bullying and report them to trusted adults, appropriate authorities and in online tools.

Description: Stop engaging in negative online social interactions.

Description: Identify examples of how perspectives and values influence decision-making.

Title: Ethical Understanding: L5 - Understanding ethical concepts and perspectives - Recognise influences on ethical behaviour and perspectives
Description: Explain how different traits, such as honesty, trust, courage and selfishness interact with responsibilities or duties to determine ethically appropriate responses.

Title: Ethical Understanding: L6 - Understanding ethical concepts and perspectives - Recognise influences on ethical behaviour and perspectives
Description: Explore and analyse examples of the tensions between conflicting positions on issues of personal, social and global importance.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Notice the use of different languages they, their family or community members use to communicate.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Identify and use verbal and non-verbal communication, recognising that these may have different meanings for familiar cultural and linguistic groups.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Initiate verbal and non-verbal communication, comparing how members of familiar cultural and linguistic groups respond.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Select strategies for open, flexible and focused communication in unfamiliar settings, considering their effect on building understanding.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Select and use strategies for open, flexible and focused communication, including understanding how cultural perspectives and world views affect communication within, between and across cultural and linguistic groups.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Communicate responsively
Description: Apply communication strategies in culturally and linguistically diverse contexts, understanding how language and culture are interrelated or connected.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Notice their own feelings, and the feelings of others, during familiar intercultural experiences.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Describe their own feelings and responses, and those of others, when discussing familiar intercultural experiences.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Describe how listening to, and understanding others, supports respectful intercultural experiences and interactions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Examine how showing empathy during intercultural experiences supports relationship-building and sustains respectful interactions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Use perspective-taking, mutual understanding and respect to sustain interactions in diverse intercultural experiences.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop empathy
Description: Analyse diverse experiences of intercultural contexts, understanding how these contexts influence their own and othersâ€™ feelings, motivations and actions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Listen to, and share opinions and reflections on, familiar topics and intercultural experiences.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Identify opinions on familiar topics and intercultural experiences, recognising reasons for different perspectives.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Discuss different perspectives on familiar topics and intercultural experiences, describing how peopleâ€™s thinking and behaviour may be influenced by a range of factors.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Examine how cultural beliefs or practices influence their own perspectives, and those of others, when discussing unfamiliar topics.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Consider multiple perspectives held on unfamiliar topics, identifying commonality and difference, and describe how perspectives may be influenced by cultural beliefs and practices.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Engaging with cultural and linguistic diversity - Develop multiple perspectives
Description: Analyse unfamiliar topics and develop respectful responses, reconciling different cultural perspectives.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Identify how people show respect in intercultural exchanges.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Consider different responses to intercultural exchanges, practising ways to show respect and develop empathy.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Use perspective-taking to develop understanding, examining how familiar intercultural exchanges influence thinking and behaviour.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Modify interactions in unfamiliar intercultural exchanges, demonstrating respect for, and understanding of, cultural diversity.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Modify responses to unfamiliar intercultural exchanges to negotiate and sustain interactions that develop mutual understanding.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Adapt in intercultural exchanges
Description: Apply learning to the challenges and benefits of interacting in a culturally diverse society, adapting thinking and behaviour to develop mutual understanding.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Notice how they, and their family members, respond in unfamiliar intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Describe how past intercultural experiences affect how they understand and respond to new experiences.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Examine the influence of past intercultural experiences on what they learn about themselves and others.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Explain how intercultural experiences affect what they learn about relationship-building and interactions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Analyse how cultural representations in a range of intercultural contexts influence self-awareness of culturally appropriate behaviour.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Consider responses to intercultural contexts
Description: Apply learning to improve communication outcomes in unfamiliar intercultural contexts, considering and developing alternative responses.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Identify examples of acceptance and inclusion within friendship groups.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Discuss examples of stereotypical statements used in familiar intercultural exchanges, reflecting on their feelings and responses.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Describe the effects of stereotyping on people in familiar intercultural exchanges, identifying actions to change perceptions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Examine how biases and stereotypes affect familiar intercultural exchanges, identifying actions that demonstrate understanding and respect.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Analyse the origins of biases, stereotypes and prejudices affecting interactions and the representation of groups, proposing actions to build awareness of experiences or impacts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Navigating intercultural contexts - Respond to biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination
Description: Apply learning to promote the wellbeing of people within unfamiliar intercultural exchanges, proposing actions to challenge biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Identify what family and friends value in familiar intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Describe how people express agreement or disagreement about what they value within familiar intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Compare how beliefs and cultural practices influence the values of different groups within familiar intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Examine the factors that influence cultural perspectives presented within intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Analyse the reasons, experiences and understandings that inform diverse cultural perspectives and world views in a range of intercultural contexts.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Examine cultural perspectives and worldviews
Description: Evaluate how common and conflicting values within and across cultural and linguistic groups affect the presentation of cultural perspectives and world views.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Identify ways in which cultures, including their own, interact.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Describe how their cultural identities influence interactions with others.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Understand how cultural and linguistic diversity affect interactions within their community.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Examine the influence of cultural and linguistic diversity on familiar interactions, and identify opportunities or challenges for relationship-building.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Explain the influence of cultural and linguistic diversity on unfamiliar interactions, identifying opportunities to show respect for cultural traditions.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Explore the influence of cultures on interactions
Description: Analyse the influence of culture on interactions within and across cultural and linguistic groups, developing opportunities for exchange and collaboration.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L1 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Identify cultural practices that are important to themselves, family and friends, and describe what they experience.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L2 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Explore examples of cultural practices that draw themselves, family and friends together, identifying how respect is conveyed.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L3 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Describe the similarities and differences in beliefs, values and cultural practices in the community, sharing how belonging grows.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L4 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Examine how beliefs, values and cultural practices convey meaning and influence peopleâ€™s sense of identity and belonging.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L5 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Identify and describe beliefs, values and cultural practices that have changed over time and those that have remained the same, drawing on examples from within, between and across cultural groups.

Title: Intercultural Understanding: L6 - Reflecting on culture and cultural diversity - Reflect on the relationship between cultures and identities
Description: Evaluate examples of beliefs, values and cultural practices for connections between cultures and identities, including their own.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud decodable or familiar texts word by word, with emphasis on one-to-one matching.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads with some intonation and expression.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads decodable or familiar texts by phrasing 2 words at a time with some attention to expression.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads accurately at an efficient pace without overt sounding and blending.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud a decodable or simple text at a reasonable pace, grouping words into meaningful phrases (see Understanding texts).

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Uses punctuation cues, and some intonation and expression.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Maintains pace and accuracy when reading with an experienced reader.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud an elementary text at a flowing pace, pausing to attend to more complex punctuation.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads without finger tracing.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Uses effective intonation, stress and expression that indicate comprehension.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud a range of moderately complex texts with fluency and phrasing, adjusting pace, volume, pitch and pronunciation to enhance meaning and expression.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud with expression that reflects the authorâ€™s purpose and meaning (see Understanding texts).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Varies pace according to purpose and audience.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Consistently and automatically integrates pausing, intonation, phrasing and rate.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Fluency
Description: Reads aloud a range of complex and highly complex texts which include multisyllabic words and complex sentences with fluency and appropriate expression.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Completes familiar phrases in texts including chants, songs and poems.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Echoes modelled phonemes and pairs of rhyming words e. G. Repeats single phonemes such as /a/ and single-syllable rhyming words such as 'in' and 'tin'.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Participates in rhymes and chants and songs including in home language or dialect (see Listening).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Consistently says the first phoneme of a spoken word (e. G. 'good' - /g/).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Listens and identifies rhyming words from a choice of up to 4 one-syllable words (e. G. 'sing', 'thing', 'dog', 'wing').

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Listens to a group of words and indicates those that start with the same phoneme and says other words that start with that phoneme.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally blends and segments words with two and three syllables (e. G. 'hopp-ing', 'fam-i-ly').

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally blends initial consonants with following letters to say a one syllable word (e. G. 'm/um' = 'mum', 'h/at' = 'hat', 'sh/o p' = 'shop').

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Provides a word when given a starting phoneme (e. G. /p/ - 'picture').

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Segments a short, spoken sentence of three to five words into separate spoken words.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Identifies first and final phoneme in a word.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Identifies the number of phonemes that make up a spoken one-syllable word comprised of less than 4 phonemes.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally blends 2 or 3 phonemes together to make a one-syllable word (e. G. 'a-sh', 's-u-n', 'b-i-n', 'sh-i-p').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally segments words of two or three phonemes into separate phonemes (e. G. 'c-a-t', 's-u-n', 'k-i-ck').

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Identifies the number of phonemes that make up a spoken, one-syllable word comprised of less than 5 phonemes.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Identifies the vowel phoneme in single-syllable words.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally blends four phonemes together to make a one-syllable spoken word (e. G. 's-t-o-p' - 'stop').

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Orally segments spoken words comprised of four phonemes into separate phonemes (e. G. 'fresh' - 'f-r-e-sh').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to add a final phoneme at (e. G. 'me' becomes 'meet').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to add an initial phoneme (e. G. 'all' becomes 'ball').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to delete a final phoneme (e. G. 'puppy' becomes 'pup').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to delete an initial phoneme (e. G. 'cat' becomes 'at').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to substitute a final phoneme (e. G. 'bet' becomes 'bell').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to substitute a medial phoneme (e. G. 'mat' becomes 'met').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonological awareness
Description: Says the new word when asked to substitute an initial phoneme (e. G. 'cat' becomes 'bat').

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Indicates words and letters in a variety of situations in the environment (e. G. In written texts, on a whiteboard) (note: not required to read the word or say the sound or name of the letter).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Distinguishes own name from a small number of alternative words.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies own name or familiar names when presented in written form.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies pictures, words, spaces between words and numerals in texts (e. G. Points to/indicates pictures, words and spaces around words in a continuous text).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies two or more letters that are the same in 2 words (e. G. 'bird', 'red').

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Recognises some familiar words and identifies them in environmental print (e. G. For example, labels, shop names, street signs).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Blends phonemes for taught single-letter graphemes to decode vowel-consonant (VC) words (e. G. 'at') and consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) words (e. G. 'hop').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies and names letters for taught single-letter graphemes.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies first phoneme in words.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Orally segments CVC words (e. G. 'c-a-t', 'h-a-t').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Recognises taught graphemes when represented in various fonts, capitals and lower-case (e. G. 'Aa', 'Rr', 'Dd').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Says the most common phoneme for taught single-letter graphemes (e. G. 'Tt', 'Mm', 'Ss').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads taught high-frequency words in a text and in the environment (e. G. 'the', 'to', 'I', 'no', 'said').

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Blends phonemes for all common, single-letter graphemes to read VC words (e. G. 'in') and CVC words (e. G. 'pan') and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Identifies and names letters for all single-letter graphemes including those represented in various letter styles, capitals and lower-case (e. G. 'Bb', 'Gg').

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads single syllable words with common double consonants and applies this when reading decodable texts (e. G. 'ss' - 'fuss', 'II' - 'will', 'ff' - 'puff').

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Says the most common phoneme for all single-letter graphemes.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Segments and writes VC and CVC words with letters in correct order and reads them aloud.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Writes/selects corresponding graphemes for all common phonemes.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads an increasing number of taught high-frequency words in decodable texts and own writing (e. G. 'was', 'you', 'one', 'said', 'have', 'were').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Blends phonemes for all common, single-letter graphemes to read consonant-consonant-vowel-consonant (CCVC) words (e. G. 'blot') and consonant-vowel-consonant-consonant (CVCC) words (e. G. 'list') and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Gives examples of phonemes that can be represented by more than one consonant (e. G. 'ck', 'ph').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads one-and two-syllable words with common suffixes (e. G. '-ed', '-ing', '-s/es') and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts (e. G. 'jumping', 'boxes').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads single-syllable words with taught consonant digraphs and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts (e. G. 'sh', 'ch' and 'ck' â€“ 'ship', 'rich', 'lock').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with split digraphs (e. G. 'cake', 'blame').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with taught common vowel graphemes (e. G. 'ee', 'ea', 'ie', '-e' and including '-y') and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Segments and represents CCVC and CVCC words containing consonant digraphs and/or clusters of consonants (e. G. 'ch-o-p', 'w-i-sh', 'b-e-s-t').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads an increasing number of taught high-frequency words in decodable texts and different contexts (e. G. Own writing, shared reading).

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads 2-syllable words with open or long vowel sounds when reading decodable texts (e. G. 'label', 'project', 'even').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads and writes common, one- and two-syllable words with clusters of consonants (e. G. 'plant', 'string', 'object').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with taught vowel digraphs (e. G. 'ee', 'oo', 'ay', 'ai', 'ea', 'oa', 'ow') and applies this knowledge when reading decodable texts.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads most common high-frequency words (e. G. 100 or more) in continuous text.

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Applies common phonic generalisations when reading continuous texts (e. G. Soft 'g' - 'age', hard 'g' - 'game').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads CCVCC words (e. G. 'trust'), CCCVC words (e. G. 'scrap'), CCCVCC words (e. G. 'thrust') and applies this knowledge when reading continuous texts.

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads multisyllabic words with common double graphemes and applies this when reading continuous texts (e. G. 'ss' - 'blossom', 'tt' - 'letter', 'zz' - 'fizzy', 'ff' - 'offend').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with graphemes representing diphthongs when reading continuous texts (e. G. 'ou' - 'ground', 'ow' - 'cow', 'oi' - 'boil').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with r-controlled vowel diagraphs 'ar', 'er', 'or', 'ur', 'ir', writes words accordingly and applies this knowledge when reading continuous texts (e. G. 'ir' - 'bird', 'er' - 'sister', 'ar' - 'card', 'ur' - 'hurt', 'or' - 'word').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Says and represents the new word when asked to delete a phoneme within an initial blend of a single-syllable word (e. G. 'spat' - 'sat').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads high-frequency words within a continuous text accurately and without hesitation (see Fluency).

Title: Literacy: L7 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads new words containing taught grapheme-phoneme correspondences in a variety of contexts without using obvious sounding-out strategies.

Title: Literacy: L8 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads less common graphemes that contain alternative spelling for phonemes (e. G. /ch/tch/j/g/) and applies this knowledge when reading continuous texts.

Title: Literacy: L8 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads multisyllabic words with more complex letter combinations and letter clusters (e. G. '-igh' - 'right', '-tion' - 'station', '-ough - 'cough').

Title: Literacy: L8 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads multisyllabic words, including those with prefixes and suffixes, and applies this knowledge when reading continuous texts (e. G. 'in-', 'ex-', 'dis-', '-ful', '-able', '-ly').

Title: Literacy: L8 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Reads words with silent letters in digraphs and applies this knowledge when reading continuous texts (e. G. 'kn' - 'knot', 'mb' - 'lamb').

Title: Literacy: L9 - Reading and viewing - Phonic knowledge and word recognition
Description: Uses grapheme-phoneme knowledge and blending skills to read continuous texts containing multisyllabic, complex and unfamiliar words quickly and accurately (see Understanding texts, Fluency).

Title: Literacy: L1a - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts
Description: Shows interest in familiar people, events and activities (e. G. Tracks the speakerâ€™s movements, turns head in the direction of the speaker).

Title: Literacy: L1b - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts
Description: Responds consistently to social interactions with familiar people.

Title: Literacy: L1b - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts
Description: Uses informal responses which can include vocalising, facial expressions, gestures, moving, touching (e. G. Touches a target object in response to a question or directive).

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Demonstrates interest in texts.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Recognises images in texts.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Recognises some icons or symbols from the environment (e. G. Familiar logos).

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Vocabulary
Description: Names familiar objects in texts including texts in the environment (e. G. Apple, table, boy).

Title: Literacy: L1 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Vocabulary
Description: Names some familiar icons or symbols in the environment (e. G. School crossing sign).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Answers simple literal questions about texts read by a proficient reader.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Invents a spoken text based on images.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Repeats fragments of text.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Processes
Description: Distinguishes between print and images.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Processes
Description: Imitates reading behaviour, by turning pages, swiping the screen and inventing own version of the text.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Processes
Description: Recognises symbols and words in texts (e. G. Recognises own name).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Processes
Description: Shows awareness of correct orientation of text (e. G. Holds the book or tablet the right way up).

Title: Literacy: L2 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Vocabulary
Description: Identifies familiar images in texts and comments by adding some detail (e. G. Â€œthe dog is wetâ€_x009d_).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Answers and poses mainly literal questions about the text.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Engages in group discussion about a text or shared learning experience.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Infers and then describes obvious cause and effect relationships (e. G. Uses information in the text to infer why a character is smiling in an image).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Listens actively and responds to a range of texts read by others.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Reading and viewing - Understanding texts - Comprehension
Description: Makes a simple statement about the content of a text (e. G. 'it was about the farm').

Title: Literacy: L3 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Description: Recalls specific information from a spoken text (e. G. Recalls a message from a school assembly announcement).

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Responds to simple and elementary texts (see Text complexity).

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Uses learnt vocabulary and simple adjectives to recount key ideas from heard text.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Describes tone and intonation of spoken text (e. G. 'she spoke with an angry tone').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Infers meaning that may be less obvious (e. G. Infers beach context from hearing background sounds of seagulls and surf).

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Listens for cohesive vocabulary to support comprehension (e. G. Listens for temporal connectives such as 'first', 'then', 'finally' and conjunctions such as 'also' to identify next section in text).

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Responds to elementary texts (see Text complexity).

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Asks relevant questions to extend understanding.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Describes language and audio features of the text.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Identifies main ideas of a spoken text using supporting details.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Identifies purpose and intended audience of a spoken text.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Infers layered meaning from texts (e. G. Musical overlay that creates mood).

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Responds to moderately complex texts (see Text complexity).

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Responds to texts with unfamiliar content.

Title: Literacy: L7 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Description: Identifies and analyses how spoken language is used for different effects.

Title: Literacy: L7 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Responds to complex texts (see Text complexity).

Title: Literacy: L7 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L8 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L8 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L8 - Speaking and listening - Listening
Description: Evaluates strategies used by the speaker to elicit emotional responses.

Title: Literacy: L8 - Speaking and listening - Listening

Title: Literacy: L1a - Speaking and listening - Speaking

Title: Literacy: L1 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas

Title: Literacy: L1 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Makes simple requests.

Description: Shares feelings and thoughts about the events and characters in text.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Uses appropriate volume for small audiences.

Title: Literacy: L2 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas

Description: Uses simple connectives to join ideas (e. G. 'and then') (see Grammar).

Description: Uses simple language to compare and contrast (e. G. 'smaller', 'more').

Description: Creates short texts using a few connected sentences, on familiar and learnt topics (e. G. Retells a familiar story or describes a process).

Description: Speaks audibly and clearly to a familiar audience (e. G. Own class).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Uses some extended sentences.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Uses some varying intonation or volume for emphasis.

Title: Literacy: L3 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses connectives to sequence ideas (e. G. 'first', 'then', 'next', 'finally') (see Grammar).

Description: Uses some modal language to influence or persuade (e. G. 'should', 'will') (see Grammar).

Title: Literacy: L3 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses some precise vocabulary from learning areas.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Elaborates on ideas using a short sequence of sentences.

Description: Includes video and audio enhancements to spoken texts, where appropriate (e. G. Includes slides or pictures in a spoken presentation).

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Incorporates learnt content into spoken text.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Plans and delivers spoken presentations using appropriate structure and language.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Sequences ideas and events appropriately.

Title: Literacy: L4 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Uses mainly correct grammatical constructions (e. G. Pronoun references; noun-verb agreement).

Description: Varies volume and intonation to suit purpose and audience.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Includes details and elaborations to expand ideas.

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Rehearses spoken text to accommodate time and technology.

Description: Uses technologies or audio and visual features to enhance spoken text (e. G. Videos a spoken presentation with music, sound effect enhancements).

Description: Selects more specific and precise words to replace general words (e. G. Uses 'difficult' or 'challenging' for 'hard').

Title: Literacy: L5 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses a broader range of more complex noun groups/phrases to expand description (e. G. 'protective, outer covering').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Does research to prepare spoken texts.

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas
Description: Shows increasing awareness of audience by moderating length, content and delivery of spoken texts.

Description: Uses abstractions (e. G. 'freedom', 'fairness').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses language creatively (e. G. 'the moon shines bravely').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses sensory vocabulary to engage the audience (e. G. 'a gasp of dismay').

Title: Literacy: L6 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary

Description: Uses a range of emotive language appropriate to topic, purpose and audience.

Title: Literacy: L7 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses a range of evaluative language to express opinions or convey emotion (e. G. 'significant benefits', 'devastating consequences').

Title: Literacy: L7 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Vocabulary
Description: Uses figurative language (e. G. 'hungry for success').

Title: Literacy: L8 - Speaking and listening - Speaking - Crafting Ideas

Description: Uses a range of rhetorical devices and humour to engage an audience.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Writing - Creating texts - Crafting Ideas
Description: Observes others writing with interest and attention.

Title: Literacy: L1 - Writing - Creating texts - Crafting Ideas
Description: Shares ideas using icons and images.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L5 - Social management - Leadership
Description: Devise a plan for leading action and evaluate the appropriateness of various leadership approaches in the process.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L6 - Social management - Leadership
Description: Propose, implement and evaluate strategies to address needs at local, regional, national or global levels.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L1 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Demonstrate perseverance with familiar tasks when first attempts are unsuccessful, and adapt attempts as needed.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L1a - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Persevere when attempting to complete tasks.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L2 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Demonstrate perseverance and adaptability with unfamiliar tasks.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L3 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Demonstrate perseverance when faced with challenges, adapting approaches based on successes and learning from setbacks and failure.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L4 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Adapt approaches to tasks to support perseverance when faced with challenging or unfamiliar tasks.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L5 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Select, apply and refine strategies to persevere when faced with unexpected or challenging contexts.

Title: Personal and Social capability: L6 - Self-management - Perseverance and adaptability
Description: Devise, evaluate and adapt strategies to engage with unexpected or challenging situations.
